winner.text: Add goku and Vegeta fighting with octopus

decision_note: Built as an homage rather than the trademarked characters: two original spiky-haired rival fighters, Sonny and Prinz, who now and then drop in to fight Gåmson. They land, trade insults and power up; Gåmson rises; a different run of moves each time (teleport punches, his swats and ink, charged beams, the two fighting each other); a stray beam smashes his rock and sends his loot home; Tåhgong comes to the rescue (the squid stays, as the creator asked); they bow and fly off. The cube can join in and earn a charm.
